correctness.rationale: Derived the reset-age survival S_n=(1-gamma)_n/n! and renewal mass u_m=(gamma)_m/m! for hazard gamma/(n+1). At gamma=1/2 the age law is the symmetric beta-binomial product of central-binomial coefficients. Averaging Bell states after n phase gates gives an X-state with coherence Phi_t=sum_n w_(t,n)*exp(i*n*theta); direct spin-flip concurrence equals |Phi_t|. Its exact generating function is [(1-z)(1-z*exp(i*theta))]^(-1/2), which is the Legendre generating function after w=z*exp(i*theta/2), proving Phi_t=exp(i*t*theta/2)*P_t(cos(theta/2)). All t roots in (-1,1) are simple and give exactly t separability phases with linear cusps; the arcsine characteristic-function limit proves C_t(s/t)->|J_0(s/2)|, and classical zero convergence gives scaled node limit 2*j_(0,k). Fixed interior phases obey the displayed Hilb oscillatory t^(-1/2) expansion. Independently propagated exact rational reset-age probabilities through horizon 20 and matched the beta-binomial and theta=pi Legendre amplitude. Finite checks do not prove all t or asymptotic zeros.
